from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path(__file__).parent
s=(p/'upstream/default.variant.tsx').read_text().replace('AnimatePresence, motion','AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion').replace('@/cuicui/utils/cn','./cn')
s=s.replace('export default function DynamicSettingsVariant1() {','export default function DynamicSettingsVariant1() {\n  const reduce = useReducedMotion();')
s=s.replace('  return (\n    <nav', '  const reduce = useReducedMotion();\n  return (\n    <nav')
s=re.sub(r'transition=\{\{(.*?)\}\}', r'transition={reduce ? {duration:0} : {\1}}',s,flags=re.S)
s=s.replace('toast.message("Changes done", {','toast.message("本地演示回执", { id: "settings-demo",').replace('description: "Changes validated and applied successfully"','description: "仅演示，未应用或保存设置"')
s=s.replace('className="size-8 transform-gpu','aria-label={isOpen ? "Close settings" : "Open settings"}\n              className="size-8 transform-gpu')
s=s.replace('placeholder="Add a new prompt"','aria-label="Prompt" placeholder="Add a new prompt"').replace('type="submit"','type="button"')
s=s.replace('key={item.label}', 'aria-pressed={index === selected}\n          key={item.label}').replace('key={button.label}', 'aria-pressed={subMenuSelected === button.slug}\n          key={button.label}')
(p/'src/settings.tsx').write_text(s);(p/'src/cn.ts').write_bytes((p/'upstream/cn.ts').read_bytes())

gaps: 固定入口与根MIT已核，未构建，依赖许可尚未全链核验。
Dimensions明确TODO；比例状态未上提，Prompt未受控；Apply仅关闭和toast，没有实际验证或应用。
本项无远程媒体/导出/剪贴板缺口；不得补写功能后冒称原版已完成。
焦点/Escape/可访问名称与减少运动待验证；与现有设置和变形浮层重合，暂不恢复。

knownGaps: Dimensions is an upstream TODO, no slider or real dimension editing implemented.
Apply only closes the local panel and shows a Sonner demonstration receipt; nothing is saved/applied remotely or persisted.
Aspect selection and uncontrolled prompt reset on section unmount as upstream; no persistence invented.
Motion initial reduced preference tested; no claim of immediate dynamic OS-preference change.
Browser pixel/layout/animation and native keyboard default activation not visually tested.
